priorityList: Interrupt with Mind Freeze when the target is casting.
Maintain Remorseless Winter at all times, especially when talented into Gathering Storm.
Cast Reaper's Mark when Pillar of Frost is ready or nearly ready.
Cast Pillar of Frost on cooldown, ensuring Breath of Sindragosa (if talented) is ready to follow.
Activate Breath of Sindragosa off-GCD while Pillar of Frost is active.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury during Pillar of Frost, ideally near the end of the window to maximize strength buffs.
Use Empower Rune Weapon if you are low on Runes (less than 2) or lack Killing Machine procs.
Cast Howling Blast whenever Rime is active or if Frost Fever is not ticking on your targets.
Cast Frostscythe if you have Killing Machine active, especially if you have 2 stacks.
Cast Obliterate with Killing Machine procs, prioritizing targets affected by Trollbane's slow from Rider of the Apocalypse.
Cast Frost Strike on targets with 5 stacks of Razorice if talented into Shattering Blade.
Cast Glacial Advance as your primary Runic Power spender in AoE situations.
Use Frostscythe as a filler when Killing Machine is not active and Pillar of Frost is down.
Use Obliterate as a secondary filler when not in a Pillar of Frost window.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities during Pillar of Frost or while Breath of Sindragosa is active.
